name: SurveyMonkey
description: SurveyMonkey is an online survey and forms platform for collecting feedback, running research, analyzing responses, and sharing insights.
best_for: Teams and researchers that need structured surveys, feedback collection, advanced survey logic, analysis, and a large integration ecosystem.
features: AI-assisted survey creation and response analysis
Skip, branching, randomization, and other survey logic
Email, web-link, SMS, QR-code, and embedded collection methods

tiers.name: Basic
tiers.notes: Free plan for simple surveys, forms, and quizzes. SurveyMonkey says free users can create unlimited surveys but are limited to 10 questions per survey and limited responses.

tiers.name: Team Advantage
tiers.notes: Starts at 3 users and is billed annually. Includes unlimited surveys and questions and 50,000 responses per year for the team plan shown on SurveyMonkey's current US pricing page.

tiers.name: Team Premier
tiers.notes: Starts at 3 users and is billed annually. Includes 100,000 responses per year plus advanced logic, white-label branding, multilingual surveys, and crosstabs on the current team pricing page.

pros: Free entry plan and paid team plans for broader response volumes and collaboration
400+ expert-built templates and 25+ question types on SurveyMonkey's current feature pages
Advanced logic, AI-assisted survey creation and analysis, and 200+ integrations for connected research workflows
cons: The free plan limits questions and visible response capacity compared with paid plans
Team Advantage and Team Premier require at least three users and annual billing
Advanced research, branding, and administration capabilities are concentrated in higher-tier or enterprise plans

faq.question: Does SurveyMonkey have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. SurveyMonkey's Basic plan is free. Its current pricing documentation says free users can create unlimited surveys, while free surveys are limited to 10 questions and limited responses.

faq.question: How much does SurveyMonkey cost for teams?
faq.answer: SurveyMonkey's current US team pricing lists Team Advantage at $30 per user per month and Team Premier at $92 per user per month, both starting at three users and billed annually.

faq.question: Can SurveyMonkey build surveys with AI?
faq.answer: Yes. SurveyMonkey's current feature documentation includes Build with AI for generating surveys and AI-assisted tools for analyzing response data.

alternatives.name: Typeform
alternatives.description: An interactive forms and surveys platform focused on conversational form experiences, logic, integrations, and branded data collection.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prioritize polished, conversational forms and lead-capture experiences

alternatives.name: Jotform
alternatives.description: A no-code form builder with a large template library, payments, conditional logic, workflows, and broad form customization.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that need flexible operational forms, payments, and high template variety

alternatives.name: Qualtrics
alternatives.description: A research and experience-management survey platform with advanced logic, statistical analysis, dashboards, and enterprise research workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations that need advanced research methods, analysis, and enterprise-grade survey workflows
